instruction: A plump walrus sculpted from soft modeling clay, with visible thumbprints, fingernail seams and slightly lumpy proportions. Its body is mottled putty-brown with a rosy blush on the cheeks, two stubby off-white tusks and a bristly muzzle poked with little tool holes. Small flipper stubs press flat against the ground as it leans back on a rounded belly.
